mc.client.resources.PlayerSkin.name: net.minecraft.entity.player.SkinTextures
mc.client.resources.PlayerSkin.note: 1.21.9 起 SkinTextures 移到 net.minecraft.entity.player 包（Mojmap 同步移到 net.minecraft.world.entity.player.PlayerSkin）；皮肤贴图由 texture() 改为 body().texturePath()

mc.entity.Entity.name: net.minecraft.entity.Entity
mc.entity.Entity.note: 1.21.9 起 Yarn 改名：getWorld() -> getEntityWorld()、getPos() -> getEntityPos()；Entity#getServer() 已删除，改用 getEntityWorld().getServer()；伤害/击杀仍需 ServerWorld 参数

mc.world.Level.name: net.minecraft.world.World
mc.world.Level.note: Yarn 名为 World（Mojmap Level）；1.21.9 起 isClient 字段改为 private，统一用 isClient() 方法

mc.entity.player.ServerPlayer.name: net.minecraft.server.network.ServerPlayerEntity
mc.entity.player.ServerPlayer.note: Yarn 名为 ServerPlayerEntity；server 字段为 private，取服务器用 player.getServerWorld().getServer()（1.21.9 起 Entity#getServer 也已删除）

mc.client.Minecraft.name: net.minecraft.client.MinecraftClient
mc.client.Minecraft.note: Yarn 名为 MinecraftClient，实例 MinecraftClient.getInstance()；1.21.9 起 MinecraftClient.IS_SYSTEM_MAC 删除，改用 SystemKeycodes.IS_MAC_OS（net.minecraft.client.input）

mc.client.Screen.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.Screen
mc.client.Screen.note: render(DrawContext, int, int, float) 签名不变；1.21.6 起 GUI 改为「先收集后渲染」：drawTexture/drawGuiTexture 首参改为 RenderPipeline（RenderPipelines.GUI_TEXTURED，net.minecraft.client.gl），像素 UV 参数不变；getMatrices() 返回 org.joml.Matrix3x2fStack（pushMatrix/popMatrix/translate(x, y)，没有 z）；drawText 等不再返回宽度；refreshWidgetPositions 用于重新布局；1.21.9 起输入回调改为事件对象：keyPressed(KeyInput)、charTyped(CharInput)、mouseClicked(Click, boolean doubleClick)、mouseReleased(Click)、mouseDragged(Click, double, double)

mc.client.KeyMapping.name: net.minecraft.client.option.KeyBinding
mc.client.KeyMapping.note: Yarn 名为 KeyBinding；1.21.9 起分类不再是字符串：构造为 new KeyBinding(翻译键, InputUtil.Type.KEYSYM, 键码, 分类)，分类用 KeyBinding.Category.create(Identifier.of(MODID, "main")) 创建一次并复用（重复创建会抛异常）

mc.client.BlockEntityRenderer.name: net.minecraft.client.render.block.entity.BlockEntityRenderer
mc.client.BlockEntityRenderer.note: 1.21.9 起改为 BlockEntityRenderer<T, S extends BlockEntityRenderState>：实现 createRenderState()、updateRenderState(T, S, float, Vec3d, ModelCommandRenderer.CrumblingOverlayCommand) 与 render(S, MatrixStack, OrderedRenderCommandQueue, CameraRenderState)，绘制经 queue.submitXxx 提交；注册仍用 BlockEntityRendererFactories.register

fabric.client.KeyBindingHelper.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.keybinding.v1.KeyBindingHelper
fabric.client.KeyBindingHelper.note: KeyBindingHelper.registerKeyBinding(new KeyBinding("key.modid.x", InputUtil.Type.KEYSYM, GLFW.GLFW_KEY_R, CATEGORY))；1.21.9 起 CATEGORY 为 KeyBinding.Category.create(Identifier.of(MODID, "main")) 得到的对象，不再是字符串

fabric.client.EntityRendererRegistry.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.rendering.v1.EntityRendererRegistry
fabric.client.EntityRendererRegistry.note: 1.21.9 起已废弃，改用原版 EntityRendererFactories.register(MY_ENTITY, MyRenderer::new)（net.minecraft.client.render.entity）；渲染器需配套渲染状态
